new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_repair_sqs_attribute_limit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from localstack.services.sqs.provider import SqsProvider
+from localstack.services.sqs.models import StandardQueue
+from localstack.services.sqs.exceptions import InvalidParameterValue
+
+
+class MessageAttributeBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    LIMIT = 262144
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.context = SimpleNamespace(region='us-east-1', account_id='000000000000')
+        self.service = SqsProvider()
+        queue = StandardQueue('repair-boundary', 'us-east-1', '000000000000',
+                              {'MaximumMessageSize': str(self.LIMIT)}, {})
+        resolver = patch.object(self.service, '_resolve_queue', return_value=queue)
+        resolver.start()
+        self.addCleanup(resolver.stop)
+        self.url = 'http://localhost:4566/000000000000/repair-boundary'
+
+    def send(self, body, attributes):
+        return self.service.send_message(
+            context=self.context, queue_url=self.url, message_body=body,
+            message_attributes=attributes,
+        )
+
+    def test_string_attributes_are_part_of_the_limit(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(InvalidParameterValue):
+            self.send('x' * self.LIMIT, {'k': {'DataType': 'String', 'StringValue': 'v'}})
+
+    def test_binary_payload_at_boundary_is_delivered(self):
+        attributes = {'k': {'DataType': 'Binary', 'BinaryValue': b'abcdefgh'}}
+        body = 'x' * (self.LIMIT - 15)
+        self.send(body, attributes)
+        result = self.service.receive_message(
+            context=self.context, queue_url=self.url,
+            message_attribute_names=['All'], wait_time_seconds=0,
+        )
+        message, = result['Messages']
+        self.assertEqual(message['Body'], body)
+        self.assertEqual(message['MessageAttributes'], attributes)
+
+    def test_binary_payload_one_byte_over_is_rejected(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(InvalidParameterValue):
+            self.send('x' * (self.LIMIT - 14),
+                      {'k': {'DataType': 'Binary', 'BinaryValue': b'abcdefgh'}})
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

(

fi
python -m unittest tests/unit/test_repair_sqs_attribute_limit.py
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
